item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Teaching innovation in higher education: active strategies and digital environments for university learning. (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-15 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Brescia
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PAED-02 Ricerca educativa: didattica, pedagogia speciale e pedagogia sperimentale

The project integrates research on the foundations of university didactics with the study, design and experimentation of innovative and active teaching models, methodologies and devices in higher education contexts, with particular attention to the digital dimension. The project aims to investigate how active teaching strategies, capable of fostering participation, collaboration and students’ active role, can be integrated in a pedagogically grounded way with digital technologies in face-to-face, online, blended and hybrid learning environments, using empirical research methods, including design-based approaches.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Time perspective and health risk behaviors in adolescence (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-02 Psicologia dello sviluppo e dell'educazione

The project aims to investigate the risk and protective factors underlying health-risk behaviors during adolescence. The study focuses on the role of time perspective and self-regulation processes in dysfunctional eating behaviors and the problematic use of alcohol and other substances. Its objective is to contribute to the development of scientific knowledge that can support the design of targeted prevention and well-being promotion interventions. The research includes a systematic review of the scientific literature aimed at identifying the main temporal and emotional-motivational predictors of health-risk behaviors in adolescence.
